# bioexcel/biobb_analysis/gmx_cluster

## Summary

Wrapper of the GROMACS cluster module for clustering structures from a given GROMACS compatible trajectory.

GROMACS cluster can cluster structures using several different methods. Distances between structures can be determined from a trajectory. RMS deviation after fitting or RMS deviation of atom-pair distances can be used to define the distance between structures.

Nextflow adapter of the [GMXCluster](https://biobb-analysis.readthedocs.io/en/latest/gromacs.html#module-gromacs.gmx_cluster) building block of [biobb_analysis](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_analysis) 5.3.1.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_ANALYSIS_GMX_CLUSTER } from 'bioexcel/biobb_analysis/gmx_cluster'

workflow {
    BIOBB_ANALYSIS_GMX_CLUSTER(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_structure_path` | yes | tpr, gro, g96, pdb, brk, ent | Path to the input structure file |
| `input_traj_path` | yes | xtc, trr, cpt, gro, g96, pdb, tng | Path to the GROMACS trajectory file |
| `input_index_path` | no | ndx | Path to the GROMACS index file |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_pdb_path` | yes | xtc, trr, cpt, gro, g96, pdb, tng | Path to the output cluster file |
| `output_cluster_log_path` | no, opt-in | log | Path to the output log file |
| `output_rmsd_cluster_xpm_path` | no, opt-in | xpm | Path to the output X PixMap compatible matrix file |
| `output_rmsd_dist_xvg_path` | no, opt-in | xvg | Path to xvgr/xmgr file |
| `versions_biobb_analysis` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_analysis', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of GMXCluster properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_cluster_log_path: 'log']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_analysis container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_ANALYSIS_GMX_CLUSTER' {
        ext.properties = [fit_selection: 'System']
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fit_selection` | string | "System" | Group where the fitting will be performed. If **input_index_path** provided, check the file for the accepted values. Values: System, Protein, Protein-H, C-alpha, Backbone, MainChain, MainChain+Cb, MainChain+H, SideChain, SideChain-H, Prot-Masses, non-Protein, Water, SOL, non-Water, Ion, NA, CL, Water_and_ions. |
| `output_selection` | string | "System" | Group that is going to be written in the output trajectory. If **input_index_path** provided, check the file for the accepted values. Values: System, Protein, Protein-H, C-alpha, Backbone, MainChain, MainChain+Cb, MainChain+H, SideChain, SideChain-H, Prot-Masses, non-Protein, Water, SOL, non-Water, Ion, NA, CL, Water_and_ions. |
| `dista` | boolean | false | Use RMSD of distances instead of RMS deviation. |
| `nofit` | boolean | false | Do not use least squares fitting before RMSD calculation. |
| `method` | string | "linkage" | Method for cluster determination. Values: linkage, jarvis-patrick, monte-carlo, diagonalization, gromos. |
| `cutoff` | number | 0.1 | RMSD cut-off (nm) for two structures to be neighbor. |
| `binary_path` | string | "gmx" | Path to the GROMACS executable binary. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
